browse and launch the learnr tutorials bundled with PlinkMatrix

Source: R/tutorials.R
PlinkMatrix_tutorials.Rd

browse and launch the learnr tutorials bundled with PlinkMatrix

Usage

PlinkMatrix_tutorials(name)

Arguments

name

character(1) name of a tutorial to launch directly (the tutorial's directory name under inst/tutorials, as reported by learnr::available_tutorials(package = "PlinkMatrix")). If missing, a menu is presented in interactive sessions; in non-interactive sessions the available tutorial names are printed and an error is raised.

Value

invisible(NULL) if name is supplied; otherwise, invisibly, a named logical vector recording which tutorials are marked done. As a side effect, launches one or more learnr tutorials, typically in the default web browser, via learnr::run_tutorial.

Details

Lists the learnr tutorials shipped with this package – covering matrix foundations, the Singular Value Decomposition, Principal Components Analysis, and ancestry discrimination using the package's example genotype data. With name supplied, that tutorial is launched directly. With name missing in an interactive session, a menu is shown with a checkbox beside each tutorial already marked done; the menu keeps returning after each tutorial finishes (offering to mark it done) until you choose 0 to quit. Progress is kept in a small file in your own R user data directory (see R_user_dir), so it survives restarting R; it is self-reported and is not sent anywhere. Each tutorial has its own "Exit tutorial" button that cleanly stops the tutorial's web server and returns control to the R console, so there is no need to interrupt with Ctrl-C. Requires the learnr package.

Examples

if (interactive()) PlinkMatrix_tutorials()
